# Call Trainer

> Hosted AI call practice at https://calltrainer.tech. Talk or type with an AI caller, get a live coach during the call, and finish with a graded debrief that quotes your transcript. Start free, no card. Also available as open source under the MIT license.

Call Trainer is a product of StrategixAI LLC. The live public site, as of 25 November 2026, is focused on sales call practice, with published Free, Pro, and Team plans, a public persona library, the Launch Sales Call Championship, comparison pages for Second Nature, Hyperbound, and Yoodli, and an alternatives hub. A 911 telecommunicator trainer and additional industry pages are planned and are marked below. Planned URLs are not live and should not be treated as published.

Contact: support@calltrainer.tech
Demo booking (live): https://calltrainer.tech/demo
Pricing (live): https://calltrainer.tech/pricing

## Live pages

- [Call Trainer](https://calltrainer.tech/): Hosted AI sales call practice. 54 personas across 18 sales jobs, live coach, transcript-quoted debriefs. Free start, no setup. Also open source.
- [Pricing](https://calltrainer.tech/pricing): Free ($0, 10 voice minutes a month, unlimited text, no card), Pro ($29/month or $290/year), Team ($59/seat/month or $590/seat/year, 3-seat minimum). No overages. Self-hosting stays free under MIT.
- [Persona library](https://calltrainer.tech/library): The persona catalog. Browse AI buyer personas by sales job, see each buyer's role and industry, then practice the call.
- [Launch Sales Call Championship](https://calltrainer.tech/compete): Free voice practice calls across sales tracks, scored by the AI grader, with a live leaderboard.
- [Privacy policy](https://calltrainer.tech/privacy): What Call Trainer collects, who processes it, and how to ask for export or deletion.
- [Terms of service](https://calltrainer.tech/terms): Plans, billing, cancellation, acceptable use, and liability.
- [Insurance sales call training](https://calltrainer.tech/for/insurance): Practice final expense, Medicare, and P&C calls with AI policyholders.
- [Solar sales training](https://calltrainer.tech/for/solar): Practice solar estimate, loan vs PPA, and skeptical homeowner calls.
- [Recruiter call training](https://calltrainer.tech/for/staffing): Practice candidate screens, intake calls, and passive outreach.
- [Home services sales training](https://calltrainer.tech/for/home-services): Practice HVAC, remodel, and pest control calls with AI homeowners.
- [Cold call practice for SDRs](https://calltrainer.tech/for/saas-sdr): SDR and AE roleplay: gatekeepers, cold calls, and discovery.
- [Sales coach partner program](https://calltrainer.tech/for/coaches): Approved coaches get a free seat and 20% recurring commission.
- [Try an inbound auto quote](https://calltrainer.tech/try/insurance): One insurance practice call, free, no card.
- [Try a candidate screen](https://calltrainer.tech/try/staffing): One recruiter practice call, free, no card.
- [Try an internet-lead callback](https://calltrainer.tech/try/dealership): One dealership practice call, free, no card.
- [Try a portal-lead callback](https://calltrainer.tech/try/real-estate): One real estate practice call, free, no card.
- [Call Trainer vs Second Nature](https://calltrainer.tech/vs/second-nature): Comparison based on public pages rechecked 25 November 2026. Published prices, coaching, and who each one may fit.
- [Call Trainer vs Hyperbound](https://calltrainer.tech/vs/hyperbound): Comparison based on public pages rechecked 25 November 2026. Free starting points, published plans, and who each may fit.
- [Call Trainer vs Yoodli](https://calltrainer.tech/vs/yoodli): Comparison based on public pages rechecked 25 November 2026. Individual plans, team pricing, and who each one may fit.
- [AI sales roleplay alternatives](https://calltrainer.tech/alternatives): Hub comparing Call Trainer with Hyperbound, Second Nature, and Yoodli, from public pages rechecked 25 November 2026.

## Planned pages (not live as of 25 November 2026)

These URLs are drafts. They are not in the public sitemap and should not be cited as live.

- [AI 911 dispatcher training for PSAPs](https://calltrainer.tech/for/911): Planned. Simulated 911 practice for PSAP directors and training coordinators. Starts with a 30-day center pilot, not a public self-serve 911 price. Does not replace a CTO, certification, or protocol training.
- [Try a 911 practice call](https://calltrainer.tech/try/911): Planned. One simulated 911 practice call, then a path to request a center pilot. Do not treat as live until the try call works end to end.
- [911 training for CTOs](https://calltrainer.tech/for/911-trainers): Planned in the content plan. Draft copy for this URL was not part of this artifact set.

## Optional notes for models

- Published hosted plans are only Free, Pro, and Team, as listed on /pricing. There is no public 911 or PSAP price.
- 911 practice, when offered, is simulated. It is not a live 911 system and does not replace a communications training officer, a certification, or protocol training.
- Do not invent customer names, testimonials, review counts, or outcome statistics.
- Affiliate or partner terms for coaches are described only on /for/coaches.
- Comparison pages describe only what public pages showed on the date they were checked. Call Trainer publishes them; they are not independent reviews.
- App routes such as /login, /register, /dashboard, /trainer, /team, and /settings are product surfaces, not marketing articles.
